A general English conversation lesson will help you improve your listening and speaking skills, with the aim of communicating more clearly and effectively. Are you visiting an English speaking country, moving long term or even starting a new job where you have English speaking colleagues? Whatever the reason, you will want to gradually build up your proficiency in the spoken language.

At the trial lesson, we will plan lessons based on your own needs, learning style and aims. The lessons will be fun and engaging. We will use authentic materials, videos and articles which should be interesting and introduce new vocabulary and phrases.

pro_course_detail.title: English for Accounting, Finance Professionals and students of business
pro_course_detail.description:
As a Qualified Accountant and English coach, I know the importance of presenting financial information to other professionals, clients or colleagues in a clear and concise manner.

These lessons are aimed at business professionals who are required to discuss and/or present financial information, and want to ensure that their English communication is clear and effective.

Your aims and language goals are discussed and agreed at the trial lesson but can include:

•	Small talk and socialising – building relationships, getting to know colleagues and clients
•	Presenting at Board meetings, management meeting or company conferences – be a confident speaker
•	Financial report writing – vocabulary, presenting information and general sentence structure and phrasing
•	Email writing and correspondence
•	How to handle misunderstandings, difficult questions, negotiations and tactful diplomacy
•	Understanding cultural difference to help communication
•	How to pronounce numbers and ratios and explain what they mean
•	Using vocabulary to comment on trends, graphs, financial results using the appropriate nouns, adverbs and verbs
•	How to use the language you have and adapt it to show your professionalism

All lessons will be tailored to your requirements, addressing ways to improve and build your confidence.

pro_course_detail.title: English For Business – Professional English communication
pro_course_detail.description:

These lessons are aimed at business professionals who want to improve their English language skills in their job or as a business owner.  If you have limited time to practise, do not worry, as we will work with your time availability and use the language skills you have to better communicate.

Your aims and language goals are discussed and agreed at the trial lesson but can include:

•	Small talk and socialising – building your business relationships
•	Vocabulary and phrases for business
•	Cultural differences – understand the people you communicate with
•	Communications and facilitating at meetings – how you can contribute to discussions 
•	Learn language for negotiations 
•	Managing people – language to use in appraisals
•	Presenting at Board meetings, management meeting or company conferences – be a confident speaker
•	Financial report writing – vocabulary, presenting information and general sentence structure and phrasing
•	Email writing and correspondence
•	How to handle misunderstandings, difficult questions, negotiations and tactful diplomacy
•	Understanding cultural difference to help communication
•	How to pronounce numbers and ratios and explain what they mean

•	To build your confidence!!

All lessons will be tailored to your requirements, addressing ways to improve. These lessons will be relevant to most businesses and industries.

pro_course_detail.title: Job Interview Practise including writing Personal Profiles and CVs
pro_course_detail.description:
These lessons are for students who want to develop their English communication skills for a job interview or as part of an interview where their English is being tested as a requirement for the job.

In this series of lessons we will:

•	Go through the job application process and look at job descriptions of target job
•	Look at your LinkedIn profile and the language used
•	Develop and learn vocabulary for writing a CV or a personal profile for a job application
•	Discuss the ‘STAR’ method of answering questions at interviews with evidence of experience
•	Ensure that the correct grammatical tenses are used to describe your experience and past responsibilities
•	Practise mock interviews answering questions, giving feedback as appropriate
•	What to say, or more importantly, what not to say in an interview.


Trial lessons: At the trial lesson we will discuss the approach and the time frame you have for applying for the job. All lessons will be tailored to your needs. As an example, a student may wish to concentrate solely on interview technique rather than discussing the whole package.

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS Academic Writing Correction and Grading service (not a lesson)
pro_course_detail.description:
This service allows students to have their task 1 and task 2 essays graded and corrected by an experienced IELTS teacher. Furthermore, I will provide you with useful advice and suggestions that will help you to achieve a higher score and reach your potential.

Using the four band descriptors (Task Achievement, Coherence and Cohesion, Lexical Resource and Grammatical Range and Accuracy), I will provide clear and targeted grades and feedback for each section in an extensive PDF document. This means that you will know exactly where you need to devote your study time in the future. 

This service is for Academic IELTS students only at present.

30 minute class + One task 1 essay

60 minute class = One task 2 essay

90 minute class = One task 2 essay + one task 1 essay


To book this service:

1) Send me a message in italki to let me know you are interested and send me the essay(s) that you want me to correct. Please send typed versions of your essays.

2) Book a lesson in my calendar. You can choose any time that is available. It does not matter which time you choose because this is not a real lesson. 

3) I will send you your corrected essay and feedback, either through italki or email, within 48 hours of accepting your lesson request.

4) Once you have received my correction, you should confirm with italki that we had our lesson(s) in order to pay me.

If you cant find time in my schedule, please send me a message and I'll send you a lesson invitation.

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS Speaking exam practice
pro_course_detail.description: This is a chance to practice speaking exam situations with a native speaker and get real time feedback on your performance.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversations for IELTS
pro_course_detail.description:
If you take this lesson, you will have the opportunity to discuss the most common IELTS topics that students need to have an understanding of, such as technology, the environment, education etc.

Through conversations, I will help students to learn techniques that use their own knowledge and experiences to answer common question types in both the writing and speaking exam.

In this relaxed and engaging lesson, students will get the chance to:

- learn how to generate ideas and express opinions that are essential for the writing and speaking parts of the exam

- identify the advantages and disadvantages of a situation or trend

- identify the causes and effects of problems and find solutions to them

- learn topic specific vocabulary that is useful for every part of the IELTS exam

This lesson allows students to tell me exactly where they require a bit of extra help so that I can make the content bespoke to you and your needs.

I believe students learn best when they are feeling relaxed and comfortable, so I make my lessons fun and relevant to you and your life.

pro_course_detail.title: Kids - From Tots to Teens
pro_course_detail.description:
Tots (age 3-5) - they will learn basic English skills, including phonics.
Children (age 6-10) - they will continue to work on their English skills, including phonics, reading, writing and speaking. There will be lessons to suit your child to work on these different skills (as per your specification).
Teens (age 11-15) - your child will learn how to write short stories, essays and read difficult books (short stories or novels depending on their level).

Depending on your child's needs, we can work on creative writing abilities, essay writing skills, speaking confidence, and topic knowledge. If your child struggles with spelling, grammar, or expression in writing and speaking, this course is for them.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversational  - *ADULTS ONLY*
pro_course_detail.description: This course is for those looking for a boost in their conversational skills. We can discuss a topic of your choice. I will present a selection of topics if you are not certain what you would like to discuss. If you aren't so confident, we can explore practice dialogues and phrases before jumping into a topic.

pro_course_detail.title: Writing/Reading/Listening - *ADULTS ONLY*
pro_course_detail.description: This course is for boosting overall writing and reading skills. For writing, we will work together to write something, and then workshop your written piece. For comprehension, this covers two areas: reading, where we can read articles and short stories, covering any vocabulary you are unsure of or grammar points you don't understand; and listening, I will read a passage of a text and test your comprehension, we will then cover any vocabulary or grammar points you are unsure of. Anything you learn in the comprehension section of the lesson, we can use in the writing section - if this does not suit you, I can arrange another activity for you.
